jobs.title: ANALISTA SR - SEG. INFORMACAO
jobs.description:
O esporte nos move, e acreditamos no seu poder de transformar vidas.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.

Nosso propósito é levar o esporte para todas as pessoas: do atleta do dia a dia ao apaixonado por performance, daquele que busca bem-estar ao que expressa sua personalidade ao se movimentar.

Queremos ser **referência em esporte no Brasil** e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

No nosso time, todo mundo tem espaço para jogar e evoluir.

**E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?**

#SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

 **Responsabilidades e atribuições**  
  
O desafio:  
Buscamos alguém para ser referência técnica em segurança de nuvem no Grupo SBF. Você vai definir os controles e padrões de segurança da infraestrutura, construir com os times de plataforma e SRE a forma de aplicá-los via código e conduzir incidentes em cloud de ponta a ponta. O modelo é de parceria: a segurança define o quê e o porquê, e a engenharia executa o como, com nosso apoio.  
  
O que você vai fazer:  

* Postura e vulnerabilidades: triar findings de postura, de vulnerabilidades de infraestrutura e de pentests. Classificar por risco de negócio e contexto (exposição, attack path, combinações tóxicas), encaminhar ao time responsável com SLA e validar a correção.
* Revisão de design de segurança: conduzir revisões de novas arquiteturas, ambientes, exposições públicas e serviços que tratam dados sensíveis, com profundidade proporcional ao risco, do checklist assíncrono ao acompanhamento contínuo do projeto.
* Guardrails e baselines: desenhar controles preventivos no nível de organização e conta e manter baselines de hardening versionados e revisados periodicamente (identidade, rede, dados, logging, compute e containers).
* Segurança como código: revisar IaC, definir gates de segurança na pipeline (scan de IaC, policy-as-code) e garantir que as correções sejam feitas no código, tratando o drift de configuração.
* Identidade e acesso: definir políticas de menor privilégio para identidades humanas e não humanas, conduzir revisões periódicas de acesso e eliminar credenciais de longa duração e acessos ociosos.
* Kubernetes e containers: definir controles para clusters, imagens, admission control e runtime security, junto com plataforma e SRE.
* Detecção e resposta: manter um catálogo de casos de uso de detecção para o control plane da nuvem, escrever runbooks e conduzir incidentes: escopo, uso de credenciais, persistência, preservação de evidências, contenção, erradicação e post-mortem. Facilitar exercícios de simulação (tabletop).
* Interface com AppSec: cuidar da segurança das identidades e permissões de pipelines de CI/CD e, quando um segredo vaza, avaliar o impacto na nuvem e coordenar a revogação.
* Métricas e conformidade: acompanhar indicadores de postura e resposta (SLAs, MTTD/MTTR, aderência a benchmarks) e manter evidências de controles para auditorias e para a LGPD.
* Referência técnica: apoiar os pontos focais de segurança nos times de plataforma, conduzir office hours e treinamentos, escrever padrões e playbooks e comunicar risco à liderança.

  
  
  
**Requisitos e qualificações**  
  
O que buscamos:  

* 5+ anos em segurança da informação, sendo 3+ dedicados à segurança de nuvem pública em ambiente produtivo de grande escala.
* Profundidade em GCP ou AWS e capacidade de transpor conceitos para o outro provedor.
* Domínio prático de IAM (incluindo identidades não humanas), redes em nuvem, criptografia/KMS e logging nativo.
* Experiência real com segurança de Kubernetes e containers, incluindo admission control.
* Automação com Terraform e Python (ou Go), com controles de segurança na pipeline de CI/CD.
* Experiência em gestão de vulnerabilidades e de postura com SLAs, priorização por contexto e acompanhamento da correção junto a times donos.
* Experiência em resposta a incidentes em cloud, com investigação a partir de audit logs.
* Uso aplicado de CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK (Cloud) e NIST CSF 2.0, e conhecimento de LGPD.

  
Diferenciais:  

* Certificações: Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, CKS, CCSP ou CCSK.
* Detection-as-code e experiência com SIEM.
* Runtime security para containers.
* Segurança de workloads de IA (ex.: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
* Segurança da cadeia de suprimentos de software (SBOM, assinatura de imagens).
* Experiência em ambientes regulados (ex.: PCI DSS) e em varejo/e-commerce de alto volume.

  
Dia a dia:  

* Atua como consultor: viabiliza a entrega com segurança e prefere guardrails automáticos a aprovações manuais.
* Prioriza por risco de negócio e tem senso de dono sobre a postura do ambiente.
* Escreve bem (design docs, ADRs, runbooks, relatórios) e se comunica com engenharia e com executivos.
* Desenvolve outras pessoas e compartilha conhecimento com o time.

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas.

Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar.

Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, ou da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, aqui o movimento não para.

Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead two squads: **Platform** and **Integrations**. Platform owns the foundation every product squad builds on: infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, identity/auth and developer tooling. Integrations connects Super Dispatch with partners and third-party systems. Reporting to the CTO, you'll set technical and product direction for both teams, run delivery and grow your engineers, while staying hands-on in the code.

### **What You'll Do**

Execution & delivery

* Act as product owner for Platform and Integrations work: gather needs from product squads and partners, prioritize them and turn them into a clear roadmap.
* Turn requirements into well-scoped, sequenced work, and set and hold delivery milestones for both teams.
* Track team health at each stage of the SDLC; unblock bottlenecks and adjust process as needed.
* Keep both teams aligned with other Engineering squads, and communicate roadmap, trade-offs and risk clearly to Product, Engineering and other stakeholders.

Technical leadership

* Set a technical vision tied to company goals and plan ahead for scale.
* Own the technical roadmap for both teams, including strategic tech debt: identify it, size the cost/benefit and drive prioritization.
* Stay hands-on: write and review code in Java, Python or Go when the team needs it, and weigh in on system design, API contracts and scaling trade-offs.
* Work closely with infrastructure and DevOps (cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring), join incident RCAs for production issues and help keep the platform reliable.
* Set the bar for engineering quality: PR review standards, test coverage for new code, a rollback plan before any deploy, and monitoring and alerts that are actively maintained.

People

* Run regular 1:1s, coaching and performance reviews; guide career growth and delegate ownership.
* Own headcount planning, hiring and onboarding for both teams.
* Track and improve engineer velocity and quality.

### **Competencies**

If you consider yourself an eager learner, a conscientious worker, and a thoughtful, kind, supportive human, you might just thrive at Super Dispatch.

To be successful, you will need a combination of problem-solving, technical, and communication skills. We expect you are:

* Proactive - you act without being told what to do. You bring new ideas to the company.
* Flexible / Adaptable - you adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions. You cope effectively with complexity and change.
* Move fast - you execute quickly and get things done.
* Growth driven - you seek growth in learning, efficiency, and celebrate wins.
* Customer focus - you are truth-seeking and can empathize with customers. You patiently listen and take feedback to solve problems for customers.
* Communication - You can comfortably communicate in English (speaking and writing). You are able to share knowledge and experience with team members via documentation.

As a manager:

* You are comfortable managing team members with different skill sets from your own.
* You can communicate expectations clearly to all team members, solicit and deliver individual feedback frequently (not just in the scope of review periods).
* You have the ability to run effective 1-on-1s, group discussions, planning sessions, and retrospectives.
* You are capable of identifying the most high-value projects and keeping your team focused on these projects.
* You can prioritize, create alignment, and provide clarity. Beyond being autonomous and guiding your team, you take ownership of problems that you see across the organization, even if they are beyond your defined responsibilities.
* You can develop processes and remove hurdles to facilitate great and fast execution by your team.
* You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and change, especially around organizational structure and the boundaries of your role. You enjoy jumping into whatever areas need attention and learning as-you-go.
* You are able to make decisions in the presence of ambiguity to create clarity for your reports and teams.
* You value empathetic and direct communication, particularly when giving and receiving feedback.
* You have expertise and interest in growing teams: interviewing junior and senior engineers, collaborating with a recruiting team, smoothly onboarding new team members.
* You have strong data-driven prioritization skills and you are unafraid to say no to any level of authority, when things don't look right.
* You have the ability to make sound "code quality vs speed of development" trade-offs.

### **Minimum requirements**

* You have Advanced-level English skills, especially Speaking and Writing.
* You have at least 3 years of experience managing engineering teams of 10-15 people; experience managing two teams at the same time is a strong plus.
* You have 5+ years of experience developing software as an IC engineer, with strong hands-on experience in **Java, Python or Golang**, and you still enjoy coding.
* You have product management experience: owning a roadmap, prioritizing with stakeholders and making scope trade-offs.
* You have DevOps/infrastructure experience (cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring). Working closely with DevOps engineers counts even if it wasn't your direct report.
* You have demonstrated experience in Lean/Agile management practices and have delivered several large projects in the past 3 years.

### **Plus points**

* Experience on Platform, infrastructure or SRE teams.
* Experience building or managing integrations: public APIs, partner integrations, webhooks, event-driven systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
* You have managed engineering teams at startups, particularly during periods of rapid growth and organizational change.
* You have rolled out engineering and management practices (code review, performance reviews, levels and ladders) where they didn't exist before.
* You've managed teams that are partially (or entirely) remote.
* Hands-on experience with Datadog and Metabase.
* Russian language.

### **What We Offer**

* Great Culture - We strive for transparency and you'll work with like minded highly motivated people excited about solving complex problems
* Remote First Culture - We're a 100% distributed team!
* Gym/Wellness Stipend - We provide a monthly stipend for gym memberships ($50/month)
* Generous Time Off - Flex PTO policy so you can take the time you need, when you need it, as well as 12 weeks paid maternity leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave
* Great gear – we'll set you up for success with the right tech and help you outfit your home office, if needed.

### **Location Requirement**

We're especially interested in candidates located in Eastern European or Central Asian regions.

**Does this sound like you? We'd love to hear from you if so.**

jobs.title: Ansible Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Red Hat Services team is looking for an experienced System administrator engineer to join us as a Red Hat Automation Technical Account Manager in Brasilia. In this role, you will provide adoption guidance, implementation of good practices and supportable insights to customers for the Red Hat Ansible and Infrastructure solutions portfolio.

Technical Account Managers (TAMs) are highly technical and experienced engineers who work with customers on their strategic needs and mission-critical environments. As part of the services organization, the TAM works on behalf of the customer as their advocate with engineering. TAM works proactively to prevent incidents. When a problem occurs, the TAM will work with the customer to resolve the incident by coordinating efforts within Red Hat.

TAM aims to support the development, deployment, and support teams, ensuring that the best practices for configuration, tuning, and use of Red Hat products are applied.

You will act proactively, with a critical eye on the customer environment providing information and insights to facilitate the adoption of the technologies, keeping the environment supported, understanding customer objectives and priorities increasing customer loyalty, understanding IT infrastructure, internal processes and business needs, facilitating collaboration with other vendors and advocating for customers.

**What you will do:**

  

* Support enterprise customers implementing containerized and platform automation solutions
* Quickly learn new technologies, including topics such as container orchestration, container registries, container creation strategies, Operating System and routine activity automation.
* Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become a guide on a customer's implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.
* Help customers achieve their business goals and outcomes by providing recommendations that will benefit customers' ongoing usage of Red Hat’s technologies.
* Attain Trusted Advisor status with both key business and technical decision makers.
* Lead Technical Health Reviews and provide relevant technical recommendations on solutions and enhancements specific to customers' business needs.
* In support of the Customer Success Strategy and Success Manager, monitor and identify trends in Red Hat adoption and utilization, Success Plan adoption and utilization, providing guidance as part of Quarterly Success reviews.
* Proactive liaison and focal point into Red Hat Technology and Product teams and Technical Support Team, to address product feature/technical hurdles.
* Provide proactive Communications in the event of a service degradation or disruption.
* Participate in issues and act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases, driving business reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Provide executive level summary status reports both internally and to the customer for all high severity cases.
* Collaborate with internal teams to improve customer satisfaction and reduce renewal risk.
* Foster existing unused product capabilities/functionality that could help customer's business.
* Serve as the customer advocate within Red Hat
* Travel regionally to visit customers occasionally

**What you will bring:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in a support, development, engineering, IT, or quality assurance (QA) organization
* Extensive technical knowledge of Red Hat Ansible Automated Platform and similar automation technologies, including Chef, Puppet, SaltStack, etc; broad knowledge of automation practices and principles
* Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like Platform-as-a-Service (OpenShift by Red Hat), containers, Kubernetes.
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers both clearly and concisely
* Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region
* Good comprehension of continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) concepts
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology-related discipline, ideally computer science or engineering
* Experience working in DevOps environments

**About Red Hat**

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

**Inclusion at Red Hat**  
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**  
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

### **Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.**

### **Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email** **application-assistance@redhat.com****. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.**

jobs.title: CLOUD MANAGER - AZURE, TERRAFORM & LANDING ZONE (HYBRID OR REMOTE)
jobs.description:
#### **CLOUD MANAGER - AZURE, TERRAFORM & LANDING ZONE (HYBRID OR REMOTE BRAZIL)**

Company hires for hybrid or remote position

* ️ Only candidates already based in Brazil will be considered

Work Model: **Hybrid for candidates living in state capitals** and **Remote for candidates living in countryside/cities outside the state capitals**

️ Language Requirements: Advanced or Fluent English for communication with US-based stakeholders

Seniority: Senior (6+ years)

Cloud Manager, Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zone, Azure Landing Zones, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, IaC, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Architecture, Cloud Infrastructure, Azure Policy, Azure Resource Manager, ARM, Management Groups, Azure Subscriptions, RBAC, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Azure Networking, IAM, Cloud Security, Cloud Governance, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, GitHub, DevOps, Cloud Automation, Enterprise Cloud, Financial Services, Banking, Wealth Management, Asset Management

Acreditamos na força da diversidade e no poder da inclusão para transformar realidades. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são estendidas a pessoas com deficiência, pessoas pretas e indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com mais de 50 anos, mulheres cadastradas em programas assistenciais de enfrentamento à violência doméstica, entre outros grupos minorizados. Seguimos firmes na construção de um ambiente justo, representativo e com oportunidades reais para todas e todos. Vem com a gente! Se você se identificou, venha fazer parte.#VEMSERDOMOPara seu conhecimento: Nesta página todas as vagas estarão identificadas como mistas ou internas. As vagas mistas contemplam tanto profissionais do mercado quanto colaboradores do Domo, enquanto as vagas internas são destinadas exclusivamente aos colaboradores que já fazem parte do Domo.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesSeus principais desafios serão:Testar de forma contínua e adversarial a eficácia de controles de segurança específicos (ex: WAF, EDR, SIEM rules, DLP, etc.) contra as técnicas de ataque mais recentes;Criar e manter um arsenal interno de scripts, ferramentas e metodologias especializadas (ex: payloads personalizados, ferramentas de phishing controlado, implants ou técnicas de evasão) para otimizar as operações do Red Team e refletir o cenário de ameaças exclusivo do banco;Atuar como um elo estratégico de "Purple Team" ao compartilhar descobertas, insights e conhecimento sobre o mindset de ataque com o Blue Team (SOC), Arquitetura e Engenharia de Segurança. jobs.title: Principal Engineer (13918)
jobs.description:
### **Vaga 100% remota**

**Aqui a gente conecta o mundo**
--------------------------------

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.  
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site: https://br.sensedia.com/sensedia-careers

### **Qual a missão do Cargo?**

O Principal Engineer direciona a evolução tecnológica da plataforma de produtos da Sensedia. Faz isso com princípios arquiteturais claros, com uma visão de futuro dos produtos e, principalmente, liderando as iniciativas de transformação que deixam a plataforma mais escalável, resiliente e segura, e alinhada aos objetivos de negócio.

Essa direção combina duas fontes. De um lado, o que acontece fora da Sensedia: mercado, concorrentes, tecnologias e tendências. De outro, o que os times de produto já definiram — objetivos, backlog, prioridades e feedback de clientes —, trabalhado em parceria com os Product Managers.

O papel atua sobretudo por influência. Nas squads, os padrões de arquitetura chegam pelos Staff Engineers; com os demais stakeholders, a relação é direta, mas sem hierarquia. Comunicação clara e capacidade de negociação fazem parte do trabalho diário. Esperamos alguém com autonomia para, diante de um desafio, transitar entre as dimensões técnica, de  
negócio e de relacionamento, e transformar isso em resultado mensurável.

  

### **Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?**

* **Definir a visão de futuro dos produtos e as iniciativas de transformação tecnológica, combinando duas frentes:** trazer para a discussão o que vem de fora (mercado, concorrência, tecnologias emergentes) e considerar o backlog e as prioridades definidos pelos times de cada produto. Os princípios arquiteturais dão coerência entre a evolução tecnológica e os objetivos de negócio.
* **Conduzir a transição da arquitetura atual para a arquitetura alvo:** mapear o estado atual, incluindo onde os requisitos não funcionais estão sendo atendidos ou não, para priorizar onde atuar, e liderar as iniciativas de transição que vão além do horizonte de um único value stream.
* **IA generativa e agêntica nos produtos**: definir como IA generativa e agêntica entra na arquitetura dos produtos — quais capacidades fazem sentido (LLMs, agentes, exposição da plataforma a agentes via MCP), onde se encaixam e com quais requisitos de segurança, custo e governança — e transformar isso em diretrizes, arquiteturas de referência e provas de conceito que os times usam na construção.
* **IA no processo de desenvolvimento de software**: contribuir com a arquitetura de como construímos software com agentes: orquestração, papéis e guardrails, e os impactos na forma de trabalho dos times.
* **Experimentar como método:** protótipos, provas de conceito e pilotos para as decisões técnicas relevantes, antes de comprometer a arquitetura, muitas vezes como parte natural do dia a dia. É o que dá espaço para a inovação e quebra eventuais resistências à complexidade de fazer diferente
* **Atuar em parceria com Produto:** acompanhar mercado, concorrentes e tecnologias em integração, API Management, Open Finance e IA, e apoiar os Product Managers nas descobertas estratégicas com a visão de viabilidade, complexidade e tecnologia, garantindo que o desenho técnico sirva ao negócio.
* **Liderar a guilda de arquitetura:** conduzir o fórum onde os temas comuns aos value streams viram decisões e padrões, escalando ao Diretor quando uma escolha comprometer a estratégia tecnológica. Ser referência para os Staff Engineers e apoiar o desenvolvimento e a sucessão da trilha técnica sênior.
* **Analisar antes de recomendar, e negociar até a decisão:** estruturar toda recomendação técnica (problema, requisitos, cenários de solução possíveis e prós e contras), e negociar os trade-offs entre técnica, negócio e conformidade até uma solução sustentável. Nas decisões de alto risco e impacto, apoiar o desenho técnico mitigando riscos de arquitetura, conformidade, resiliência, escalabilidade e eficiência operacional.
* **Ser a face interna e externa da tecnologia de produto:** com engenheiros, C-level, outras áreas da Sensedia, clientes e analistas de mercado.
* **Ser referência técnica também na prática:** reservar tempo para entregas técnicas relevantes (código, provas de conceito, code review, troubleshooting) e apoiar as squads nos problemas de maior peso técnico.
* **Profundidade e cobertura de requisitos não funcionais:** escalabilidade, resiliência, disponibilidade, SLOs, segurança de aplicações e containers, e custo projetados na arquitetura/como critérios de desenho, e não remendados depois.

### **Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?**

* Carreira técnica longa e comprovada, transversal a múltiplos produtos ou domínios
* Histórico de decisões de arquitetura que atravessaram uma organização inteira e sobreviveram ao tempo
* Experiência prática com IA generativa e agêntica aplicada à arquitetura de produto, incluindo sistemas com LLMs, agentes e plataformas expostas a agentes (MCP, tool-use)
* Vivência em desenvolvimento de software com orquestração de agentes no dia a dia de construção
* Experiência em liderar arquitetos ou técnicos seniores por influência e exemplo, sem hierarquia
* Histórico de influenciar decisões sem autoridade formal, com a confiança de engenheiros, diretoria e C-level
* Arquiteturas distribuídas e multi-tenant em cloud, em escala
* Visão de produto, com capacidade de conectar decisões de arquitetura a objetivos de negócio e de clientes
* Comunicação e negociação com públicos técnicos e executivos, apoiadas em análise estruturada antes de cada recomendação
* Inglês avançado para leitura técnica e de mercado, e para conversa com clientes e fornecedores

  

**Contexto do ambiente:**

* Linguagens e runtimes: ecossistema JVM (Spring Boot no core, Quarkus/GraalVM no serverless), com Java 8 convivendo com Java 25; Go, Python e Node/TypeScript nos demais serviços
* Arquitetura: multi-tenant, com separação entre control plane e data plane; event-driven com Kafka e SNS/SQS
* Infraestrutura e operação: Kubernetes e GitOps (EKS, ArgoCD, Terraform) com centenas de clusters de clientes; observabilidade com OpenTelemetry
* IA: agêntica no produto e no desenvolvimento (AI Gateway, runtime MCP)

  

### **Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?**

* Experiência com API Management, Open Finance e iPaaS
* Identidade e regulatory tech: OAuth/OIDC/mTLS, perfil FAPI, Open Finance e Open Insurance (JWS, DCR, PAR)
* Espanhol
* Contexto de setores regulados e compliance (LGPD, PCI, ISO 27001)
* Experiência em gestão de pessoas

### **Aqui você vai encontrar:**

Develop reusable reference architectures and standard patterns so other engineering teams and embedded consultants can build AI solutions without rebuilding the foundation. Evaluate unit economics for AI workloads, including cost per transaction, token and inference spend, latency budgets, and build-versus-buy and self-host-versus-vendor decisions. Partner with security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to support safe and compliant AI delivery. Perform other duties as assigned. Preferred Qualifications Education & Experience: Minimum Required Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science. AI Practitioner Certifications are a plus 12+ years building and operating production software, including 4+ years delivering production AI/ML systems and 2+ years of LLM or agentic systems in production, with a track record as the most senior technical owner of an enterprise-scale platform. Deep fluency with AI-assisted development environments such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or ONA, with a track record of driving adoption and measured impact across engineering teams. Semantic routing and model orchestration, including embedding-based intent analysis, deterministic fallback logic, and policy-based model selection across multiple providers on cost, latency, and privacy criteria. Observability and AI Ops for non-deterministic systems, including distributed tracing, behavioral analysis, usage and quality metrics, drift detection, and cost and latency telemetry for executive reporting. Security-aware engineering with demonstrated experience handling PII and sensitive data, including encryption, secrets management, least-privilege access, and audit trails in a regulated environment. Model hosting and serving experience, including deploying and operating commercial and open-weight models behind a gateway or proxy, with sound self-host-versus-vendor judgment. Evaluation and reliability engineering for probabilistic systems, including eval harnesses, golden datasets, offline and online scoring, guardrails, red-teaming, hallucination mitigation, and human-in-the-loop review design. Technical leadership without formal authority, including architecture decision records, design reviews, mentoring senior and staff engineers, and communicating trade-offs to executive stakeholders. Ability to own a multi-year capability roadmap, moving work from discovery through prototype, production validation, and scale against defined business metrics. Ability to move fluidly between abstract system thinking and tactical, incremental delivery while managing stakeholders and delivering against a critical path. jobs.title: Lead Product Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings and two consecutive years of profitability. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, and we're investing in the next generation of our platform to get there.

**About the Team**

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work.

 **Requirements**

**The Role**

As a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training.

You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach.

This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight.

**What You'll Own**

* **Modeling & Analysis:** A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or R.
* **Reporting:** A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act on.
* **Analytics Engineering:** Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a must.

**Problems to Solve**

**Metrics nobody fully trusts.** Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job.

**Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything.** A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL.

**Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch.** If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck.

**A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal.** Supply, demand, pricing, and service quality all interact. Teasing out what's actually driving a metric versus what's noise is a real analytical problem, not a formality.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* The metrics teams rely on daily are trusted, documented, and current, no one's quietly keeping a shadow spreadsheet because they don't trust the dashboard.
* Routine questions are self-serve: stakeholders find their own answers in existing reports instead of pinging you for a one-off pull.
* You can name specific decisions your analysis changed, not just analyses you delivered.
* The datasets and models you've built in dbt are clean and documented enough that other analysts build on them without redoing your work.

**Who You Are**

**AI-Native:** You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar) daily to move faster: drafting and debugging SQL and dbt models, scripting analysis, and shaping reports, and you keep experimenting with new capabilities as they show up. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI tools or prefer to do everything by hand.

**Learning Mindset:** You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions before reaching for an answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique.

**Sets the Bar:** As a Lead, you work autonomously, hold your own analysis to a high standard, and raise the bar for the people around you, whether or not they report to you. Product managers and stakeholders should see you as a trusted thought partner, not an order-taker. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you want a title and a team before you're willing to raise everyone else's standards.

**Team Player:** You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you value being right over reaching the right answer together.

**Business Focus:** You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on at each. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're happiest doing analysis for its own sake, disconnected from a decision it will drive.

**Bias for Action:** You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems, you actively avoid being a perfectionist or getting tied up in knots. You have a bias for action to make progress, and you enjoy being scrappy, with constraints that enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go.

**This Role Is NOT**

* **A ticket queue.** You're not here to pull numbers on demand, you decide what's worth measuring and how to measure it.
* **A dashboard-admin seat.** Maintaining BI tooling is part of the job, not the point of it. The point is the insight the dashboard delivers.
* **A people-management role.** This is an individual-contributor seat. "Lead" describes the bar you hold yourself and others to, not a team you manage.
* **A role that waits for perfectly clean data.** If you need data handed to you pre-cleaned before you can start, this isn't the right seat, you're expected to get your hands into the warehouse.

**Tools of the Trade**

SQL and dbt for transformation and modeling, Python or R for the occasional statistical deep dive, and Lightdash as our primary BI layer for dashboards and self-serve reporting.

 **Benefits**  

* + **Base salary:** $75,000–$100,000 USD annually.
  + **AI tooling provided:** The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify.
  + **Fully remote:** This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours.
  + **Flexible PTO:** Measured on outcomes, not hours logged.

**VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER:** Please upload your English resume. Applications without it will not be considered.

Requisitos e qualificações Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Sólida experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes de TI e gestão de parceiros/consultorias. Forte domínio funcional e de processos no ambiente SAP, com ênfase nos módulos SD, MM e WM e suas interfaces. Vivência consolidada em gestão de projetos e portfólio de tecnologia, atuando desde a concepção até o roll-out. Prática na definição e acompanhamento de métricas, SLAs e KPIs operacionais e de entrega. Experiência em planejamento e controle orçamentário de tecnologia e gestão de contratos. Excelente habilidade de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e negociação com múltiplos níveis hierárquicos e áreas de negócio. Diferenciais Conhecimento e vivência no módulo ou vertical SAP AFS (Apparel and Footwear Solution). Experiência no segmento de moda, confecção e varejo (processos de compras, estoque, logística, distribuição, vendas e planejamento de coleção/produto). Vivência em projetos de modernização, transformação digital e ambientes com alta complexidade de integração entre SAP e sistemas legados. Domínio e aplicação prática de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (híbridas), ajustadas ao contexto e à complexidade de cada entrega. Informações adicionais ﻿ Desde 1880 rumo a 2154! Somos o Básico do Brasil . São mais de 145 anos de uma história da qual temos muito orgulho e, todos os dias, trabalhamos na construção de um futuro de prosperidade. Acreditamos na força da conexão , do protagonismo e da construção coletiva . Por aqui, cada pessoa contribui para movimentar a evolução da nossa marca, do nosso negócio e da moda brasileira. Somos sinônimo de memória afetiva, versatilidade, autenticidade e atemporalidade. Unimos passado, presente e futuro. Depois de mais de um século vestindo os brasileiros e sendo uma das marcas mais lembradas do País, já não somos apenas dois peixinhos, e sim um Cardume de talentos icônicos. E, somamos no maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina: o Azzas 2154. Quer fazer parte desse mar de talentos? #VemPraHering!
